notes: The held registry record has hasResults=false and no posted results. Selected death by day 28 in PMID 36942789, matching the named CAP trial and all-cause mortality outcome; the source reports day 28 rather than the row timepoint of 30-day or in-hospital. The abstract states 800 randomized and 795 analyzed; the witnessed denominators are the printed analyzed arm totals, and the abstract does not explicitly label this population intention-to-treat. Alternative mortality counts in PMID 32876689 are 11 hydrocortisone deaths and 20 placebo deaths by day 21 in the COVID-19 population (randomized arm totals 76 and 73); these are not the named trial report. Its 32/76 and 37/73 counts are the composite treatment-failure outcome, not mortality alone. The registry protocol also lists day-90 all-cause mortality but supplies no results.
